question: Who won the gold medal in the women's individual recurve event at the Archery World Cup Stage 3 held in Paris in June 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepika Kumari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deepika Kumari** won the gold medal in the women's individual recurve event at **the Archery World Cup Stage 3 held in Paris in June 2021.**
 
• At the Archery **World Cup Stage 3 competition in Paris,** the talented Indian archer Deepika Kumari set a new world record by winning three consecutive gold medals.
 
• With four gold medals, India took first place in the medal count.
 
• **Abhishek Verma won the fourth gold medal for the compound section's men's solo event.**
 
• Indian professional archer **Deepika Kumari competes in the archery event and is now rated No. 1 in the world.**
 
• She won the women's individual recurve gold medal at the 2010 Commonwealth Games. 

 [IMAGE: https://img.olympicchannel.com/images/image/private/t_1-1_600/f_auto/v1538355600/primary/duzvb4nsfjye1wxw1jij] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The World Archery Federation has ranked **Ankita Bhakat,** an Indian recurve archer, as the 20th best in the world.
 
• Since joining the national recurve squad in 2007,** Bombayla Devi Laishram** has competed internationally for India as an archer.
 
 
• She has won four gold, five silver, and four bronze medals at different Archery World Cup competitions, as well as a silver medal at the World Archery Championships.
 
 
 
• **Dola Banerjee** is an Indian sportswoman who competes in archery.
